title: Asian soybean rust control trials in Brazil: 17,845 results from 37 Embrapa publications
description: 17,845 trial results on the control of Asian soybean rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi) in Brazil, transcribed from the tables of 37 open-access Embrapa publications (2005-2026), including the national summaries of Embrapa Soja's cooperative fungicide trials for 22 of the 23 seasons from 2003/04 to 2025/26 (no summary was found for 2007/08): treatment, dose and timing, place, season, measured variable (severity, yield, control efficacy, AUDPC and others) and value, with the page and table of origin. An exploratory analysis follows the control efficacy of each product across seasons. Each document was transcribed twice, independently, by AI agents, and every disagreement was settled against the PDF; a human reviewed the result before publication. Part of the Paper Rerun project (Open Tables).
